- [NDBG.17.4] **O(log N) reverse navigation** ([NDBG.14r.2]). The
  reverse index is built at recording load time (O(N) once), or as a live
  run is recorded; all reverse-navigation operations are O(log N) binary
  search plus checkpoint re-drive. Conforming adapters must pre-index — lazy
  scanning is not permitted.
